preconditions.description: The number of actions is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each action is in the format 'X posted on Y's wall' or 'X commented on Y's post' or 'X likes Y's post'
preconditions.description: Each action is one of the specified formats.

preconditions.expression: All names are lowercase and consist of at least 1 letter and at most 10 letters.
preconditions.description: The names in the input follow the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: Your name is given in the first line of input.
preconditions.description: The first line of input is your name.

postconditions.expression: The output contains m lines, where m is the number of distinct names in the input excluding yourself.
postconditions.description: The number of output lines is correct.

postconditions.expression: Each line in the output contains one name.
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly one name.

postconditions.expression: The names in the output are sorted by the priority factor with you in descending order, and by alphabetical order when priorities are equal.
postconditions.description: The output names are sorted according to the specified criteria.

postconditions.expression: The output includes all names present in the input data excluding yourself, even if their priority factor is zero.
postconditions.description: All relevant names are included in the output.
